summary:
Reed Blankenship is an NFL safety who went from undrafted rookie to starter with the Philadelphia Eagles and won Super Bowl LIX. He played college football at Middle Tennessee, where he was a two-time first-team all-conference selection and finished as the school’s all-time tackles leader.

Philadelphia signed Blankenship in 2022. He earned a starting role and recorded 113 tackles and three interceptions in 2023. In 2024, he added 78 tackles and a career-high four interceptions, then helped the Eagles win the Super Bowl.

On March 13, 2026, Blankenship signed a three-year, $24.75 million contract with the Houston Texans.
